Where to code

The same AI agent runs in many places. Pick the one that matches how comfortable you are with computers today. You can switch later.

At a glance

Chat is for questions, Claude Code is for projects

A Claude chat is great for asking questions of one CSV. For building anything with more than one file, or with teammates, use Claude Code (in Civic Spark, your terminal, or claude.ai/code) instead of pasting code into a chat: Claude Code works on the real files, and a shared repository keeps everyone on the same copy.

Not writing code today?

Most starter projects have plenty of work that needs no keyboard at all. An AI assistant helps with these too.

Ask questions of the data

Upload a CSV from the data catalog to a Claude chat and ask: What are the ten most common tree species, and do any break the 10-20-30 rule?

Write the civic story

Every project needs a clear question, a plain-language explanation, and a list of who would use it. Draft them with Claude, then edit them in your own voice.

Test what the coders built

Be the first real user. Click everything. Try it on your phone. Write down what confused you. That is the most useful QA a team gets all day.

Terminal in 60 seconds

If you picked the terminal, these are the only commands you need before Claude takes over. Type the command and press Enter.

Mac and Linux, with the Windows PowerShell equivalent in brackets
Type thisWhat it does
pwdShow which folder you are in.
lsList the files here. (dir in CMD; ls also works in PowerShell.)
cd folder-nameMove into a folder. cd .. goes back up one.
claudeStart Claude Code in the current folder. It can see this folder and everything inside it.
Ctrl+CStop whatever is running. Press it twice to leave Claude Code.

Still not sure? Answer two questions

Quick decision guide
If you…Use
have never opened a terminal, or have no GitHub accountCivic Spark (Track A)
have a Claude subscription and a GitHub accountclaude.ai/code or the desktop app
already code in VS Code or a JetBrains IDEThe terminal install plus your editor's extension
want to keep building after todayThe terminal install, on your own laptop
